source_encoding: Complete physical source lines; trusted LF join, no unescaping or guessed repairs
compatible_legacy_schema: coding-edit-v1 with literal parsed content and the same syntax/path/size checks
syntax_validation: Non-executing Python 3.12 AST parsing before returning a patch or reserving candidate execution
syntax_failure: INVALID_PYTHON; retain usage and stop without retry, patch or candidate execution
remaining_gate: Separately authorized live acceptance for v3; do not infer success from syntax/schema tests
